lines: d34: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Vanessa Gomez is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d34: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d34: 🕯️ Vanessa Gomez is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d34: What Vanessa kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d34: "Vanessa's gone." Fernando looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Vanessa." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d34: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Harman blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Radios & Signals (Level 1). Continuity, batteries, and solder. Most dead electronics are just broken connections.
d34: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d34: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Vanessa Gomez, 34 days. The mantle passes to Harman Madhusudhan.
d34: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Harman Madhusudhan, 56 — a bush pilot. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes.
d34: The village's quarrel was with Vanessa — and Vanessa is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d34: At the grave, Fernando, Merete, Maya and 1 more speak for Harman — "Vanessa trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d34: The fire knew Harman before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
